correctness.rationale: The exact companion-matrix lift gives valuation j+9 for the difference between progression terms whose parameters differ by a number of 2-adic valuation j. The explicitly checked scalar coefficient is odd, so division by 2^9 yields an isometry. The isometry extends by completeness to Z_2, induces bijections on every finite quotient, and therefore has a unique zero tau. Valuation preservation gives nu_2(T_(1280+1792t))=9+nu_2(t-tau) for every t>=0. The verifier corroborates exact identities and finite lifts; it is not used as an infinite proof.
